messages:
marina.ch: Hey team 1 quick procurement bulletin: we've updated a few thresholds and the emergency expedite flow. Short version + links: https://redwood.internal/finance/procurement-update :point_right:

marina.ch: Key changes:
- Contractor hardware reimbursements now require finance pre-approval for items > $1,200 (was $500). Managers can still approve <$200.
- New vendor onboarding: any recurring spend forecast > $20k/year triggers full vendor questionnaire + contract review. One-off buys under $2k go through fast-path.
- P-card rules: subscriptions and SaaS trials allowed up to $1,500 with manager signoff; above that use a vendor request so we track commitments.
- Emergency/expedite: include "EMERGENCY-START" on the request and tag @finance; we aim for same-day triage for hiring start dates.

kevin_r: Quick Q 1 how does this affect conference travel for contractors? Example: flight + hotel ~ $1,100.

marina.ch: For travel, contractors follow the travel policy: ticket + hotel are reimbursed per receipt. The new $1,200 threshold is aimed at equipment only. If travel is bundled in a single vendor invoice that looks like equipment + services, flag it and we'll advise.

eli: If an existing vendor renews an annual SaaS for $18k, does that need the full questionnaire? It's under $20k but close.

marina.ch: Good catch 1 for renewals at or near the threshold, submit the vendor renewal form with estimated ARR. Finance may request the questionnaire if there's risk (data access, SOC2, custom contract). In practice, we treat recurring renewals conservatively.

zara_m: If an engineer buys a niche tool on their p-card during trial for $1,300 and it converts to a $6k/year plan, what's the retro step?

marina.ch: That should be escalated to procurement within 5 business days. We'll retro-issue a vendor request and reconcile charges. For any conversion >$5k/yr, we'll open contract review to confirm terms.

procure-bot: Vendor request submitted: id=V-2026-1102 by kevin_r, est amount $1,100. Status: queued for finance review.

kevin_r: Thanks 1 will add notes on expected renewal. Also, is there a sample "expedite justification" we should include?

marina.ch: Yes 1 use the one-pager linked in the policy ("expedite template"): include start date, blocker impact, and manager signoff. If approved, finance will route a provisional PO while onboarding completes.

eli: Appreciated. Can we get a short cheat-sheet for managers? The changes are small but folks will DM us.

marina.ch: Yep 1 we'll drop a one-page cheat-sheet and a short ribbon post in #general by EOD. Reach out to me or zara_m for edge cases. :sparkles:
